ValidationRule.description: Globally, all opportunities should be only created in Stage 1 #22221 - Exception for eCommerce opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AND( OR( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = 'Opportunity', $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = '' ), NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c) ), AND( ISNEW(), $RecordType.DeveloperName != 'CPQ_Billing_Opportunity', NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, '1 - Qualification')) ), $Label.IMExpress_Opp_Owner!= OwnerId, NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New opportunities can only be created as Stage-1
